title: Docker service discovery troubleshooting
description: Diagnose a container that cannot reach PostgreSQL because it uses the wrong Docker Compose service hostname.
tasks: Start by inspecting `docker compose` state with `python kh-lab.py status docker-network-debug`.
Inspect the application logs and determine why it cannot resolve/reach PostgreSQL.
Fix the scenario in `{workspace}/scenario.env` without changing `compose.yaml`.
Re-apply the lab with `python kh-lab.py run docker-network-debug`.
Validate your repair with `python kh-lab.py check docker-network-debug`.
hints: Docker Compose services can resolve each other by service name on the project network.
Compare the hostname in the app logs with the service names defined in compose.yaml.
The PostgreSQL service is named `postgres`; the initial scenario intentionally uses a misspelled hostname.

checks.name: Application can resolve and reach PostgreSQL
